tasks.name_en: Inspect the mini soccer ball's visible surface
tasks.name_ja: ミニサッカーボールの見える表面を確認する
instruction_variants: Inspect the visible surface of the mini soccer ball and record only observable condition.
Check the mini soccer ball for visible surface damage without rolling or throwing it.
ミニサッカーボールの表面を、転がしたり投げたりせず確認してください。
tasks.notes: Visual proposal only; it does not claim panel geometry, bounce, or other ball performance.

tasks.name_en: Inspect the softball's visible identity and surface
tasks.name_ja: ソフトボールの識別と表面を目視確認する
instruction_variants: Inspect the softball's visible identity and surface without throwing it.
Confirm the softball target and record only visible condition.
ソフトボールを投げずに、対象と表面の状態を確認してください。
tasks.notes: The proposal records visible identity and condition only; it does not assume stitching, leather, or throwing performance.

tasks.name_en: Inspect the baseball's visible surface markings
tasks.name_ja: 野球ボールの見える表面の印を確認する
instruction_variants: Inspect the baseball's visible surface markings and record their condition.
Check the baseball without assuming a particular seam or performance property.
野球ボールの見える表面の印を、性能を推定せず確認してください。
tasks.notes: The task records observable markings only; it does not require a seam, label, or sports-performance test.

tasks.name_en: Gently contact and inspect the tennis ball
tasks.name_ja: テニスボールに軽く触れて状態を確認する
instruction_variants: Use only bounded gentle contact on the tennis ball, then inspect and release it.
Gently contact the tennis ball over the soft pad; do not infer bounce or compression performance.
ソフトパッド上でテニスボールに軽く触れ、性能を推定せず確認してください。
tasks.notes: Bounded contact is a proposed interaction only; no material, compression, or bounce result is asserted, including for a replica.

tasks.name_en: Inspect the racquetball for visible surface damage
tasks.name_ja: ラケットボールの見える表面損傷を確認する
instruction_variants: Visually inspect the racquetball for surface damage.
Check the racquetball's visible condition without squeezing or throwing it.
ラケットボールを握りつぶしたり投げたりせず、表面状態を確認してください。
tasks.notes: This is a visual check only; it does not infer pressure response or play performance.

tasks.name_en: Inspect the golf ball's visible surface pattern
tasks.name_ja: ゴルフボールの見える表面パターンを確認する
instruction_variants: Inspect the visible surface pattern of the golf ball and record what is observable.
Check the golf ball's surface pattern without rolling it.
ゴルフボールを転がさず、見える表面パターンを確認してください。
tasks.notes: The pattern is recorded as an observation; no dimple function, flight, or material performance is claimed.

tasks.name_en: Lay the chain along a marked chain path
tasks.name_ja: チェーンを指定経路に沿って広げる
instruction_variants: Lay the chain along the marked chain path with every link visible.
Spread the chain on the chain layout board without introducing a tangle.
チェーンを絡ませず、印のある経路に沿って広げてください。
tasks.notes: The proposal tests controlled flexible handling and link visibility; it does not infer tensile strength.

tasks.name_en: Stack the washers on a checked training post
tasks.name_ja: 確認済みの訓練用ポストにワッシャーを積む
instruction_variants: Place every washer onto the checked washer post without scattering them.
Stack the washer set on the stable training post and verify the full set.
すべてのワッシャーを安定した訓練用ポストに積み、数を確認してください。
tasks.notes: The post and compatibility must be checked during setup; asset suitability and execution remain unverified.

tasks.name_en: Gently contact and inspect the foam brick
tasks.name_ja: フォームレンガに軽く触れて状態を確認する
instruction_variants: Use only gentle bounded contact on the foam brick, then release and inspect it.
Check the foam brick for visible damage after a low-force contact; do not infer spring-back behavior.
フォームレンガに弱く触れた後、復元性能を推定せず損傷を確認してください。
tasks.notes: The task records visible condition after bounded contact only; it does not claim a compression or recovery measurement.

tasks.name_en: Orient the die to a marked target face
tasks.name_ja: さいころを指定された面に向ける
instruction_variants: Orient the die so the marked target face is up on the dice face pad.
Set the die to the declared face without rolling or tossing it.
さいころを転がさず、指定された面を上にして置いてください。
tasks.notes: The target face is declared by the collection setup; no random-roll outcome or game result is claimed.

tasks.name_en: Inspect the marbles for cracks or chips
tasks.name_ja: ビー玉のひびや欠けを確認する
instruction_variants: Inspect every marble for visible cracks or chips on the protected tray.
Count and visually check the marbles without bouncing or dropping them.
ビー玉を落としたり弾ませたりせず、数とひび・欠けを確認してください。
tasks.notes: The protected setup accounts for the catalog description of small glass marbles; no damage-rate claim is made.

tasks.name_en: Lay the rope along a marked straight path
tasks.name_ja: ロープを指定された直線経路に沿って広げる
instruction_variants: Lay the rope along the marked straight path with both ends visible.
Uncoil the rope on the rope layout board without creating a loop in a person path.
ロープを人の通路にループさせず、印のある直線に沿って広げてください。
tasks.notes: The task tests flexible layout and entanglement avoidance only; it does not require tying or tensile-force behavior.

tasks.name_en: Arrange the cups mouth-up in size order
tasks.name_ja: カップを口を上にして大きさ順に並べる
instruction_variants: Arrange every cup mouth-up from largest to smallest in the marked zone.
Place the separated cups in the declared size order without nesting them.
カップを重ねず、口を上にして大きい順に並べてください。
tasks.notes: This is an orientation-and-order task, distinct from the Round 1 nesting task; cups are empty and dry.

tasks.name_en: Insert the blank credit card into a non-payment sleeve
tasks.name_ja: 無地カードを支払いに使わないスリーブへ差し込む
instruction_variants: Slide the blank credit card into the non-payment training sleeve until its tab remains visible.
Insert the non-functional card without using a payment terminal or applying force.
無地の非機能カードを支払い端末に触れさせず、タブが見えるまでスリーブに差し込んでください。
tasks.notes: Use only a blank non-functional card or clearly labeled replica; this task contains no financial or credential action.

tasks.name_en: Route the second rope between two marked anchors
tasks.name_ja: 別のロープ個体を二つの印付きアンカー間に通す
instruction_variants: Route the second rope along the marked path between the two low anchors.
Lay the rope between anchor A and anchor B without wrapping it around a person.
別のロープを人に絡ませず、二つの低いアンカー間の印に沿って置いてください。
tasks.notes: The anchors are low, fixed visual markers; tying, load bearing, and person contact are out of scope.

tasks.name_en: Open and inspect the clear box's empty condition
tasks.name_ja: 透明ボックスを開けて空の状態を確認する
instruction_variants: Open the clear box and inspect its empty condition and visible integrity.
Open ycb_068_clear_box without disturbing secured contents, then record only observable condition.
透明ボックスを開け、内容物を動かさず空の状態と見える損傷を確認してください。
tasks.notes: Use an empty box or secure contents below the rim; no sharp or chemical contents are introduced.

tasks.name_en: Separate the box lid for inspection
tasks.name_ja: 確認のためボックスのふたを分けて置く
instruction_variants: Separate the clear box lid and place it on the marked inspection surface.
Remove ycb_069_box_lid without prying, then leave both parts stable and visible.
ふたをこじらずに透明ボックスから分け、印のある面に安定して置いてください。
tasks.notes: The box is empty and the lid is a matching detachable part; no forceful prying is allowed.

tasks.name_en: Build an alternating color row with the wood blocks
tasks.name_ja: 色付き木ブロックで交互色の列を作る
instruction_variants: Arrange the colored wood blocks into the declared alternating color row.
Build the alternating pattern in the marked zone and verify every block is accounted for.
色付き木ブロックを指定された交互色の列に並べ、すべての個数を確認してください。
tasks.notes: The pattern rule is supplied by setup; no hidden color or block geometry is inferred.

tasks.name_en: Insert one checked peg into the marked peg-test hole
tasks.name_ja: 確認済みのペグを指定穴へ一つ差し込む
instruction_variants: Insert the checked designated peg into marked hole 1 until it is seated.
Align and place one peg in the marked hole without forcing the peg or shifting the apparatus.
確認済みのペグを指定された1番穴へ無理なく差し込んでください。
tasks.notes: Setup must verify the peg and hole fit; only one low-force insertion is proposed and no timing or score is claimed.

tasks.name_en: Place the toy airplane on the runway facing the marked heading
tasks.name_ja: おもちゃの飛行機を指定方向で滑走路に置く
instruction_variants: Move the toy airplane to the runway and face it toward the marked heading.
Place the airplane stably on the runway without throwing or pretending to fly it.
おもちゃの飛行機を投げずに滑走路へ置き、印の方向に向けてください。
tasks.notes: The task is a tabletop orientation setup only; it does not claim flight, propulsion, or aerodynamic behavior.

tasks.name_en: Connect a compatible pair of Lego Duplo pieces
tasks.name_ja: 適合するレゴデュプロの部品二つを接続する
instruction_variants: Connect the checked compatible Duplo pair with only easy seating force.
Align one Duplo piece with its compatible mate; stop if it does not seat easily.
適合性を確認したデュプロ部品を軽く合わせ、簡単に入らなければ中止してください。
tasks.notes: Use only compatible, supervised construction pieces; no brand, fit, or force result is assumed without setup verification.

tasks.name_en: Inspect the T-shirt's visible fabric condition
tasks.name_ja: Tシャツの見える生地の状態を確認する
instruction_variants: Inspect the folded T-shirt's visible fabric condition and orientation.
Check the dry T-shirt for visible damage without unfolding it.
折りたたんだ乾いたTシャツを広げず、見える生地の状態を確認してください。
tasks.notes: The task does not assume a care label, garment front, or textile performance beyond the declared dry folded setup.

tasks.name_en: Open the magazine to a marked page and inspect it
tasks.name_ja: 雑誌を指定ページまで開いて確認する
instruction_variants: Open the magazine to the marked page and leave it flat on the dining table.
Inspect the marked magazine page without bending or tearing the paper.
雑誌を指定ページまで開き、紙を折ったり破ったりせず平らに置いてください。
tasks.notes: Use a dry magazine and a removable page marker; the task records page visibility, not article content or reading comprehension.

tasks.name_en: Read the timer display without changing its setting
tasks.name_ja: 設定を変えずにタイマー表示を読み取る
instruction_variants: Read and record the visible timer display without pressing any control.
Inspect the timer's display only; preserve its setting and stopped or safe state.
操作ボタンに触れずタイマー表示を読み取り、設定と安全な停止状態を保ってください。
tasks.notes: No numeric value, timing performance, or button behavior is inferred; the device must remain off or safely paused.

tasks.name_en: Inspect the visible faces of the Rubik's Cube
tasks.name_ja: ルービックキューブの見える面を確認する
instruction_variants: Inspect the visible faces of the Rubik's Cube without turning any layer.

tasks.notes: The proposal inspects the visible face set only; it does not assume a solved state or require a layer rotation.
